messages:
jenna: Heads up — we're seeing a spike in 5xxs for /v1/generate on dedicated eu-1 pool. Customer-facing errors ~12%.
seb: I'm looking at the autoscaler and pod logs, might be related to a malformed healthcheck after the last config push. Rollback candidate ready.
liam: I've pinned traffic away from eu-1 via smart-routing to eu-2, traffic shifted ~80% within 90s. Monitoring latency/consumer errors.
anya: Noted. CC'ing @oncall-bot for pagerduty.
oncall-bot: PagerDuty incident PD-5421 created and notified the oncall rotation (:bell:). Link: https://pagerduty.com/incidents/PD-5421
jenna: Mitigation plan: rollback config on eu-1 -> rollback started by @seb.
seb: rollback started. command: ```kubectl rollout undo deployment/inference-svc -n prod --to-revision=3``` 
seb: quick log snippet from the failing pod: ```GET /healthz 503 {"error":"kv-cache OOM"}```
liam: I've temporarily increased kv-cache memory on eu-1 nodes and reduced max-batch-size to 8 for new containers.
deploy-bot: eu-1 deployment rollback completed. image: inference-svc:v1.43 -> v1.40
jenna: Traffic stabilization observed — 5xxs down to baseline. Still keeping routing to eu-2 for warm standby for 10m.
anya: Customer Success alerted key accounts, posting to status page.
ops-notify: Status page updated: https://status.redwoodinference.com/incidents/PD-5421
liam: Follow-up action items: 1) Add guard to healthcheck to avoid kv-cache OOM causing 503 2) Add autoscaler check for healthcheck flaps 3) Run canary with config sandbox. I'll file the tickets.
seb: Filing tickets now: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-7893 , INF-7894, INF-7895
jenna: Thanks all. Marking as mitigated but monitoring. Will send postmortem template in ~1h.
oncall-bot: Incident PD-5421 status changed: mitigated -> monitoring
liam: Closing the thread here, will paste postmortem link when ready.
